prompt:
Subject:
Cloud umbrella and summer sky walk

Main Figure:
A full-body shot of a woman holding a white cloud itself like an umbrella canopy under a vivid blue sky. The figure stands relatively small in the center of the lower half of the frame, making the giant sky and cloud space the main focus.

Person/Expression:
Dark brown straight hair falling below the shoulders with a side part, the ends fluttering to the left in the breeze. Profile view with brown eyes looking up at the high-held umbrella, a natural expression with lips gently closed. Slender build, bright natural skin, face rendered with a level of detail appropriate for a distant view.

Clothing/Pose:
A light blue short-sleeved cropped blouse and a matching light flared mini-skirt, with white sandals with heel straps. An unbleached thin woven bag is worn across the right shoulder. Standing at the edge of an embankment with legs lightly crossed, extending the right arm straight up holding the black thin shaft and white curved handle of the umbrella. The left arm hangs relaxed.

Background/Light:
A clear, deep blue sky occupying most of the screen. A single, horizontally long white cloud with cotton-like thickness and fine textures floats above the person, with the black umbrella shaft connected to the center of its underside. White cumulus clouds at lower levels, hazy blue-green mountain ranges, and blurry long grass in the foreground. Hard, direct sunlight from the sun in the upper right serves as the primary light source, brightly illuminating the white clothes and the cloud, creating distinct shadows.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical orientation. A low-angle full-body photo taken by placing the camera close to the ground looking up. The figure is placed slightly to the right of center, with the cloud umbrella at the upper center, leaving wide blue sky space above and to the sides. The full body and cloud are contained within the frame, with the diagonal embankment at the bottom edge. Focus on the person and the cloud, with the foreground grass blurred by a shallow depth of field. Natural compression feeling similar to a medium telephoto lens.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic photo. Transparent summer colors, a clean blue and white color scheme, natural movement of hair and thin fabric in the wind, and a plump three-dimensional feel of the cloud. Fresh and slightly fantastical, but the light on the figure and scenery is realistic.

Negative:
Do not change the cloud umbrella into a regular fabric umbrella; do not use horizontal viewpoints or close-ups of the person.
